column1: # Model pack `video` (MODEL_PACKS=image,video): ImageLab's Video mode, Wan 2.2 and MiniMax H3. Same columns and rules as image.tsv.
# Nothing here is needed for images; a pod started for images or 3D only skips it (about 147 GB).
# The Wan latent's TAESD preview decoder (--preview-method taesd), only used for video latents.
# SmoothMix Wan 2.2 14B (civitai model 1995784), T2V v4.0 + I2V v2.0, high + low noise experts. CivitAI calls them
# "Checkpoint", but they are the diffusion model only: diffusion_models, for UNETLoader. The T2V ones have the lightx2v
# speed LoRA merged in (the Video view's Fast then adds none); the I2V ones do not.
# lightx2v 4-step LoRAs: the Video view's Fast mode (4 steps, CFG 1).
# Fast video upscalers (the Video view's Upscale option). A100, 81 frames 832x480 x2: Nomos 12 s, AnimeSharpV4 20 s, ClearReality 33 s.
# --- Wan 2.2 video add-ons (2026-10-18; ImageLab's Video mode, Advanced tier) ---
# Frame interpolation: ComfyUI core's RIFE / FILM nodes (FrameInterpolationModelLoader + FrameInterpolate, PR 13258, in v0.34.5)
# read models/frame_interpolation. Comfy-Org's repack of Practical-RIFE 4.25/4.26 and Google FILM; 4.26 is the pick (no ensemble, fastest),
# heavy is sharper on big motion, lite is quickest, FILM handles larger jumps. ~137 MB all four.
# Anime Style v2 (CivitAI 2222779 I2V / 2200950 T2V, the most-downloaded Wan 2.2 anime LoRA pairs; triggers "An1meStyl3", "AnimeStyle").
# Wan 2.2 LoRAs come as a high-noise / low-noise pair; the Video mode's LoRA picker puts a name that says which on that expert.
# Newer 4-step speed LoRAs, selectable under Speed & sampling > Speed LoRA files (the defaults above stay the Comfy-Org v1 / v1.1 pairs):
# lightx2v's 2026-04-12 I2V distill as Kijai's rank-64 extraction (trained at 720p, said to keep more motion) and the T2V Seko V2.0 pair.
# --- MiniMax H3 (2026-10-19; ImageLab's Video mode, the "MiniMax H3" engine) ---
# One 33B omni model: video with its own 32 kHz stereo soundtrack, 24 fps, 5-15 s, text / first-last frame (fl2va) / reference
# pictures (ref2va). Nodes are in ComfyUI v0.34.5 itself (comfy_extras/nodes_minimax_h3.py) and KJNodes. Files are Comfy-Org's
# repack and the bundled video_minimax_h3_* templates' defaults: the pruned INT8 (convrot) checkpoints (21 GB each; the full
# bf16 is 66 GB and the pruned bf16 40 GB would not fit the pod's 41 GB video share), the NVFP4-AWQ Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder
# (16 GB; the model card says it needs no Blackwell GPU; the INT8 one is 27 GB), fp16 video VAE, fp32 audio VAE, and lightx2v's
# turbo LoRAs (8-step and 4-step for fl2va, 4-step for ref2va). ~69 GB. Licence: MiniMax community licence; Comfy's page says a
# commercial licence is required for use in the US / EU / UK / Korea.
